svg.title: The PUGZ League
svg.desc: A league season, played out: new teams sign up and are placed into a division at the placement weekend, returning teams keep the division they earned, standings move week by week, the top four play the semi-finals, Finals Night crowns each champion and lights the prize, both finalists move up and the bottom two move down. Four divisions of eight teams: Division 1, open to every rank; Division 2, no ruby; Division 3, diamond 4 at most; Division 4, platinum 1 at most. Every division has a cash prize, highest in Division 1.
